_purpose: A heist to steal the Vireya Line's prototype void-resistant embryo template before ArcGen can weaponize it. Freeborn operatives, a conflicted ArcGen insider, and a Resonance Commune saboteur who thinks they're destroying the research, not stealing it. Nobody has the full picture. The temple is alive.
scenario_hint: The Vireya Line's Central Gene-Temple on Arcadia contains something that could change everything: a prototype template for void-resistant embryos. ArcGen plans to sell it to the highest bidder - probably Tempest for weaponization, possibly ACG for debt-immune laborers. A coalition of interests has assembled this team to steal it first. But each team member has different ideas about what happens to the research after. The Freeborn want to sell it themselves. The ArcGen insider wants to leak it to everyone. The Commune operative wants to destroy it. The tech specialist doesn't care - she just wants the challenge. The temple itself is bio-engineered, semi-sentient, and will respond to intruders as an immune system responds to infection. Let the heist unfold with complications, betrayals, and the growing realization that none of them were told the truth about what they're stealing.

scenario.situation: You crouch in the bioluminescent underbrush at the edge of the temple complex, watching the living walls pulse with a slow rhythm like breathing. The Central Gene-Temple rises from the jungle canopy, its organic spires spiraling toward Arcadia's pale moons. Inside, somewhere in the research catacombs, is the Prometheus Template - void-resistant embryo genetic code that took the Vireya Line thirty years to develop. Your employer - whoever they really are - wants it. You have twelve hours before the security cycle resets and your window closes. The team assembled for this job has never worked together before. You've each been given different instructions about what happens to the template after extraction. Someone's lying about something. The temple is already aware you're here - the outer membrane has been watching since you arrived.

initial_npcs.name: Night Technician Orem
initial_npcs.description: Low-level technician working the night shift in the outer labs. Doesn't know about the Prometheus Template. Might be bribed, intimidated, or convinced to help.

initial_npcs.name: Temple Symbiote
initial_npcs.description: A semi-sentient aspect of the temple's immune system that manifests as a humanoid shape of vines and bioluminescence. Communicates in emotional impressions. May help or hunt depending on how intruders treat the temple.

_design_notes: Four specialists assembled for a heist, each with different instructions about the endgame. The Freeborn leader thinks it's a theft-for-profit. The ArcGen insider is actually a leak-activist. The Commune operative was told to destroy the research, not steal it. The tech specialist is just in it for the challenge. Let the competing agendas create tension as the heist progresses. The temple is alive and will respond to intruders. 20 rounds for infiltration, complications, extraction, and the inevitable betrayal.

players.name: Operative Shan Karsel
goals: Lead the team to extract the Prometheus Template
Sell it to the Freeborn Coalition for distribution (his actual employer)
Don't let the others know he's planning to cut them out of the profit

players.name: Dr. Celia Vireya
goals: Provide inside access and knowledge of temple security
Copy the template to leak it publicly - research should belong to everyone
Avoid being caught by her own family (she's betraying the Vireya Line)

players.name: Saboteur Vex Thaurin
goals: Help extract the template (official mission from Commune elders)
Destroy the template once extracted - void-resistant humans are abomination
The others can't know the Communes sent someone to sabotage the heist

players.name: Cipher Nyx Ossai
goals: Crack the temple's bio-security systems (the real challenge)
Document the entire heist for her portfolio (ego)
Doesn't care what happens to the template - just wants the win

_beats: Approach - temple's outer membrane watching, first security layer
Entry - exploiting Dr. Vireya's access, avoiding night staff
Outer Labs - navigating bio-hazards, temple starting to respond
First Complication - security triggered, guardians waking, time pressure
Research Catacombs - deeper into the temple, architecture shifting
The Prometheus Vault - finding the template, what it really is
Extraction Attempt - getting it out, temple in full immune response
Competing Agendas - team fractures, who betrays first?
The Choice - steal it, destroy it, leak it, or something else entirely?
Escape - whatever they chose, now they have to get out alive

_mission_objectives.description: Infiltrate the Central Gene-Temple without triggering full lockdown
Locate and extract the Prometheus Template
Escape Arcadia before security closes the net
Determine what really happens to the template (competing objectives)

notes: GENE-TEMPLE HEIST - Classic heist with competing agendas. Four specialists, each given different instructions about the endgame. The temple is alive and will hunt intruders. Let the competing objectives create tension - who betrays first? What happens to research that could change humanity? 20 rounds for infiltration, extraction, and inevitable betrayal. ALL AGENTS USE OPENAI GPT-5-MINI AT TEMPERATURE 1.0.
